hero_sub: Protecting your property. Simplifying ownership. Making an impact.
intro: TrueNorth Living leases single-family homes in North Texas on a 2–3 year corporate lease and runs them as structured sober living residences. One lease, one organization, one point of contact.

points.title: One point of contact
points.body: The lease is with TrueNorth Living, not with individual residents. The business signs it, the business pays it, and the business is responsible. One lease, one payment, one phone number.

points.title: Active property oversight
points.body: TrueNorth Living maintains active oversight of each home. Security cameras in designated common areas and exterior areas help us monitor the property, reinforce accountability, and identify concerns quickly.

points.title: Minor repairs covered by TrueNorth
points.body: TrueNorth Living will handle and cover approved minor repairs up to an agreed-upon amount, reducing routine maintenance calls and unnecessary headaches for the property owner. The specific repair responsibility and approval threshold will be clearly established in our property agreement.

points.title: Property care and preventative maintenance
points.body: We take pride in maintaining our homes. Residents are expected to keep the property clean and organized, and TrueNorth Living regularly monitors the condition of the home so minor issues can be identified before they become larger problems.

points.title: Strong good-neighbor standards
points.body: Quiet hours, curfews, guest rules and parking expectations are written into the agreement every resident signs. Neighbors get a quiet, well-kept house — and a number to call if they need one.

points.title: A 2–3 year corporate lease
points.body: We're looking for two- to three-year terms, not short-term arrangements. Turnover costs you money and costs us the community we're trying to build — so our interests line up with yours.

assurances: Every resident signs a written agreement covering conduct, cleanliness, guests and quiet hours
Zero tolerance for alcohol and illicit drugs, with regular and random testing
Residents are expected to be working, in school, or in structured volunteering
Owner-operated — you deal directly with the founders
Working toward TROHN certification, the Texas affiliate of NARR
impact_body: North Texas has far more people leaving treatment than safe places to land. Your property becomes part of the answer.
cta_body: Tell us the address and we'll walk it, talk through what we'd need, and put the specifics in writing. No obligation, and a straight answer either way.
footnote: Lease term, rent, repair thresholds and responsibilities are set out in a written property agreement negotiated per home.
proof_title: Backed — and happy to prove it.
proof_body: TrueNorth Living is financially backed. Ask and we'll show documentation that we can cover the lease term before you sign.
